description: Eight step sequencer where every step carries a probability of being skipped, with glide and reset per step

params.text: Sets the voltage its step puts out, within the range picked in the menu
The chance that its step plays rather than being skipped, 0 to 100%
While on, its step holds the gate high instead of passing the clock, which glides into the next step
While on, reaching its step sends the sequence back to the beginning, or to the end when it is running backwards
Picks the order: forwards, backwards or pendulum

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on, skipping any step the probabilities skip over
A rising edge restarts the sequence, reseeds the random generator from the Seed input and blocks the clock for 1ms
A rising edge restarts this sequencer and every UnoE chained to its right at the same moment
Sets its CV knob from the voltage on the matching channel, one channel per step, while a cable is patched
Sets the step chances, one channel per step, 0V for a step that is always skipped through to 1V for a step that always plays
A rising edge jumps the sequence straight to its step on the next clock
Sets the seed the random generator takes on a reset, so the same run of skips comes back; the seed is the voltage divided by ten and zero gives a fresh run; the tooltip on this jack reads Direction

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequence has reached
Follows the clock while the step is playing, and stays high while a step with Glide on is playing
Carries 10V on the channel of the step the sequence has reached while its gate is high, eight channels wide

menu: Range — sets the span of the CV knobs; the choices run -3V to 3V, -2V to 2V, -1V to 1V, 0V to 1V and 0V to 2V, and it starts at -2V to 2V
Quantize — rounds every step voltage to the nearest semitone
Output step address — turns the Step jack into one channel carrying the step number at 0.3125V per step
